findings.evidence: `nl -ba code/TauCeti/Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Prod.lean` shows lines 136-142 label the theorem as a pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but line 141 begins with `Prod.map ... x = ...`; Mathlib line 549 only says `coe_prodCongr ... : ⇑(h₁.prodCongr h₂) = Prod.map h₁ h₂`, so this theorem skips the `relativeProdHom` application it advertises.
findings.fix: Change the theorem to state `(relativeProdHom (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) s t p : (M × N) ≃ₘ^n⟮I.prod J, I.prod J⟯ M × N) x = ((p.1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x.1, (p.2 : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) x.2)`.
findings.issue: `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` is documented and named as the pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but its statement has left side `Prod.map ... x`, so it proves only the definitional behavior of `Prod.map` rather than how `(relativeProdHom s t p)` acts.

summary: The relative pointwise API is still mis-formalized: the advertised theorem does not state an application formula for `relativeProdHom`.
